examples.title: Example 1: Using a Dot Indicator with a Swiper Component
examples.description: This example binds the same IndicatorComponentController object to both the indicator API of the Swiper component and the IndicatorComponent constructor, enabling interaction between the dot indicator and the Swiper component.
